admin_users_external_auth_unique.name: admin_users_external_auth_unique
admin_users_external_auth_unique.where: "admin_users"."external_auth_provider" is not null and "admin_users"."external_auth_id" is not null

admin_users_external_auth_pair_check.name: admin_users_external_auth_pair_check
admin_users_external_auth_pair_check.value: ("admin_users"."external_auth_provider" is null and "admin_users"."external_auth_id" is null) or ("admin_users"."external_auth_provider" is not null and "admin_users"."external_auth_id" is not null)

admin_audit_events_actor_consistency_che.name: admin_audit_events_actor_consistency_check
admin_audit_events_actor_consistency_che.value: ("admin_audit_events"."actor_type" = 'admin' and "admin_audit_events"."actor_id" is not null) or ("admin_audit_events"."actor_type" = 'system' and "admin_audit_events"."actor_id" is null)
